dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "The Night Warden Wars have left us weary, but Unity and the hot springs will see us through."

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "Occasions such as this are beautiful indeed, yet the tainted currents have infringed upon it."

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "The golden-haired hero revealed the truth and swept the Abyss from the land..."
